verdict.rationale: Langfuse's docs state that traces are captured via 'native SDKs for Python/JS'. Separate pages confirm SDK use from Python and JS/TS, and the Python SDK is used end to end in an engineering guide. One community report of implementation bugs and confusing docs is general and does not concretely contradict SDK availability, while another user praises integration and DX. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of JS/TS SDK instrumentation (decorators, context propagation, etc.), independent hands-on corroboration of both SDKs working.
